svg.title: Mockup 11: built-in storyboards on screen
svg.text: 11 · Built-in storyboards on screen, each a few steps in the hero (or full screen where the layout has no hero)
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
a · Doors open: a countdown to the doors item, then a welcome card
Trigger: the item of kind doors, 60 s before its start. A tick each second in the last 10.

g.text: Demo Game Cup, semis · Stage · 5 min

svg.text: Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
b · Starting soon: a 2.5 s sting, then the item card until it starts
Trigger: T−5 of a tournament or ceremony item; the sting's sound counts once in the budget.
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
c · Champion: countdown, sting, the winner card with confetti
Trigger: the tournament's champion event (step 7; tested on fixtures in step 4). Fanfare once.
d · Midnight: full screen for 20 s on each night of the event
Trigger: at a time, every night. Skipped by a quiet scene, which wins (it plays silent and calm).
